name: @tank/slack-message-writer
description: Write short, scannable Slack messages with key words in bold (dyslexia and ADHD friendly) and copy them to the macOS clipboard. Covers pasted Markdown, composer markup, API mrkdwn, Markdown blocks, mentions, dates, accessibility, announcements, status and incident updates, decisions, handoffs, and review requests. Triggers: write a Slack message, draft a Slack message, Slack copy, Slack announcement, Slack update, Slack incident, Slack review request, format for Slack.
